products.name: Lantern Keeper Cotton-Blend Hoodie
products.description:
Lantern Keeper Cotton-Blend Hoodie. A hooded skeletal guardian holds a glowing red lantern beneath gothic arches, framed by a crimson moon and thorn-like ornament.

Materials & fit: A soft cotton-blend layer with a relaxed unisex fit, dropped shoulders, a double-layer drawstring hood and a spacious front pocket. Current listed fabric is 95% cotton / 5% elastane, 265 g/m². US-produced batches from October 5, 2026 use 90% cotton / 10% elastane, 330 g/m²; composition and weight can vary by production region and batch.

Care: Wash in cold water with similar colors. Avoid bleach and dry-cleaning. Use low heat when ironing and follow the attached care label for drying or any instructions specific to your item.
